explication: slashdocs is a collaborative document workspace for people and agents: authors publish self-contained HTML, reviewers read and comment on exact passages, authors revise immutable versions, and teams share documents. The graph captures the documented browser, CLI, and remote-MCP entry points, plus the server’s storage and notification layers. Source excerpts are selective; documented capabilities are retained, while unsampled implementation links are omitted unless the README establishes them.
